title: Glueing schemes along open subschemes
statement: Let $I$ be a set and let $(X_i,U_{ij},\varphi_{ij})$ be glueing data of schemes: for $i\in I$ a scheme $X_i$ [def-pc-scheme], for $i,j\in I$ an open subscheme $U_{ij}\subseteq X_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion] and an isomorphism of schemes $\varphi_{ij}:U_{ij}\to U_{ji}$, such that $U_{ii}=X_i$ and $\varphi_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$, and for all $i,j,k$: $\varphi_{ij}^{-1}(U_{ji}\cap U_{jk})=U_{ij}\cap U_{ik}$ and $\varphi_{ik}=\varphi_{jk}\circ\varphi_{ij}$ on $U_{ij}\cap U_{ik}$ (cocycle condition). Then there exist a scheme $X$ and open immersions $\psi_i:X_i\to X$ such that (1) $X=\bigcup_i\psi_i(X_i)$, (2) $\psi_i(U_{ij})=\psi_i(X_i)\cap\psi_j(X_j)$, and (3) $\psi_i|_{U_{ij}}=\psi_j\circ\varphi_{ij}$.
